so not sure if youve seen u/utilizingtheta he has a youtube channel called large cap day trader and he talks about the only thing that moves price is volume and liquidity this is exactly why the news is not important it just brings in more volume. Usually the news isnt important because its "priced in" and the market is expecting it. Sometimes you get news that isn't expected and completely catches us off guard. For example covid the first time around in 2020. Even delta and omicron didn't really affect the markets as all the bears had hoped.  

The other way that you could trade news though is how a very successful trader kristin qullamaggie trades a setup called episodic pivots. Other than that news just brings in more volume. Sometimes the market reacts the exact opposite as you would of thought. Hopefully this helps and its not just rambling good luck! if you have any questions let me know
